# Ben Stanley

> Associate Professor at the Centre for the Study of Democracy, SWPS University. Research on populism, illiberalism and authoritarianism in Central and Eastern Europe.

## Pages

- [Ben Stanley](https://benstanley.eu/)
- [Citation reach](https://benstanley.eu/pages/citation-reach.html): Updated:
- [Good Change](https://benstanley.eu/pages/good-change.html)
- [Media reach](https://benstanley.eu/pages/media-reach.html): Updated:
- [Media](https://benstanley.eu/pages/media.html)
- [Policy reach](https://benstanley.eu/pages/policy-reach.html): Updated:
- [Polish political analyses](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses.html): Interactive analyses of Polish politics: parties, elections and public opinion
- [Election results](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/election-results.html): Every presidential, Sejm, European Parliament and referendum vote in Poland since 1990: facts, results and maps of every gmina and constituency
- [Parties in the Sejm](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-genealogy.html): Polish parties in the Sejm since 1989: their genealogy, the seat strength of each party and party family day by day, and MPs' defections between clubs
- [Party ideology](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-ideology.html): Where Polish parties stand in European ideological space, from the Chapel Hill Expert Survey and The PopuList, and how they compare with their own voters
- [Party system indicators](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-system-indicators.html): Fragmentation, disproportionality, volatility, nationalisation, polarisation and government closure in the Polish party system, 1991 to the current polls
- [Social and political trends](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/political-attitudes.html): Long-run trends in Polish society and public opinion since 1990, pooled from many surveys, from left–right self-placement and support for EU membership to trust in institutions, religion and living conditions, with breakdowns by party, age, gender, education and place of residence
- [Polling tracker](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/polling-tracker.html): A Bayesian poll-of-polls for elections to the Polish Sejm, with seat projections and a scenario builder
- [Quality of democracy](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/quality-of-democracy.html): Polish democracy since 1990 in the V-Dem project's expert ratings, against Central and Eastern and Western Europe, with polarisation in V-Dem and in the Sejm's roll calls
- [Pooling the Poles](https://benstanley.eu/pages/pooling-the-poles.html): Pooling the Poles is now the Polling tracker under Polish political analyses
- [Research outputs](https://benstanley.eu/pages/publications.html): Updated:
- [Research projects](https://benstanley.eu/pages/research-projects.html)

- [English for Professional Purposes](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/english-professional-purposes.html)
- [Język angielski w zastosowaniu zawodowym](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/jezyk-angielski.html)
- [Podstawy dziennikarstwa danych](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/podstawy-dziennikarstwa.html)
- [The Social Psychology of Democracies in Transition](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/social-psychology-democracies.html)
- [Introduction to Social Research Methodology](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/social-research-methodology.html)
- [Systemy polityczne](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/systemy-polityczne.html)
